supplementary_literature.title: Efficient MoE Serving in the Memory-Bound Regime: Balance Activated Experts, Not Tokens
supplementary_literature.reading_basis: Earlier full-text audit in work/final-literature-audit.md; arXiv status refreshed2026-11-09
supplementary_literature.mechanism: Activated-expert-aware physical dispatch plus a global top-k allGather transport; changes more than expert placement.

supplementary_literature.title: Coordinated Scheduling for MoE LLM Serving
supplementary_literature.mechanism: Cross-level request scheduling and source-aware placement with migration-stability terms.
supplementary_literature.relevance: A stability gate is not novel merely because it considers temporal change; broader front-end/back-end coupling differs from the current one-inflight layer.
supplementary_literature.artifact_availability: Full system/artifact independently reproducible status not verified.

supplementary_literature.title: TEMPO: Makespan-Aware Expert-Parallel Load Balancing Across Memory- and Compute-Bound Regimes
supplementary_literature.status: preprint v2; conference publication not verified
supplementary_literature.reading_basis: Earlier full-text audit including negative cases/appendix; status refreshed2026-11-09
supplementary_literature.mechanism: Profile-based fixed-charge makespan model combining activated replicas and tile-rounded compute; off-critical-path planning and integrated dispatch/count collection.
supplementary_literature.relevance: Strongest direct warning against universal token or expert-count proxies; small BF16 configurations and communication-dominated deployment show little/no adaptive gain.
supplementary_literature.artifact_availability: Claimed https://github.com/jeshxxx/TEMPO returned404 in prior artifact check; appendix hardware anonymized. Results not independently replicated.

supplementary_literature.title: FreeBalance: Pre-Routing Online Moe Load Balancing via Residual Workload Prediction
supplementary_literature.status: preprint v1; conference publication not verified
supplementary_literature.mechanism: Residual-representation workload prediction before routing; migration swap count constrained by available overlap/cost.
supplementary_literature.relevance: Already explicitly cost/overlap constrained; predictive migration requires preceding-layer computation absent from isolated layer replay.
supplementary_literature.artifact_availability: Complete public code/data artifact not verified.
